name: Browser Development
description: In-browser editor letting a privileged developer write CSS/SCSS and JS that is compiled and applied/saved to the current theme.
project_description: Browser Development gives a signed-in developer an in-browser React/ACE editor (served at /admin/browser-development/editor) to author SCSS, live-compile it to CSS with the scssphp/scssphp library, and persist both the compiled CSS to the public filesystem and the SCSS source as a portable config entity (browser_development_storage) for version control. Because the stored SCSS is portable configuration built in a component style, the same styling can be reused across projects; combined with layout_builder_styles it lets editors attach classes to blocks/sections. The optional browser_development_assist submodule re-attaches the compiled CSS file via hook_library_info_build()/hook_page_attachments() so the main editor module can be uninstalled on production while the generated stylesheet keeps rendering. Requires Drupal 10 or 11 and the scssphp/scssphp Composer library. As shipped, every browser_development route is declared with _permission: 'TRUE' (a permission name no role can hold), so the editor and its API respond only to the superuser and are otherwise inaccessible; treat this as a local development aid, not a production feature.
